preconditions.description: The number of parts in the toy is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of ropes linking the parts is between 0 and 2000, inclusive.
The energy value of each part is between 0 and 105, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= xi, yi <= n and xi != yi for all i
preconditions.description: Each rope links two distinct parts.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total energy the child should spend to remove all n parts of the toy.
